description: ACCDB: on client static batch-optimistic (3,3,4) Recordsets of W and AutoNumber table T, capture Value/OriginalValue/UnderlyingValue/Status/EditMode on clean row, edited row before Update / after Update / after MoveNext+MovePrevious / after CancelUpdate (before vs after Update), AddNew row before Put / after Put / after Update / after MoveFirst+MoveLast / after CancelUpdate on unposted AddNew, and after UpdateBatch (plus AutoNumber ID channels). Keeps all pages before, after local staging, after UpdateBatch, after pause, and after Close.

args.text: SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, Code, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID
